Both nits applied in a single edit to guides/google-compute-engine/setup.md, in the closing paragraph of the "Configure the consent screen" step (the paragraph the first finding named as an acceptable location, and where the second finding's trigger sentence already lived):

(Nit 1, fidelity) Added the Dossier-backed 100-test-user cap for apps in Testing status, plus the guide's own already-present remedy (publish the app), so an org with more connecting users than that isn't surprised by an unannounced console limit. Resulting paragraph (guides/google-compute-engine/setup.md, lines 134-144):
"**Testing** status is temporary by design: an External app left in Testing drops every connection after seven days, and Google caps a Testing app at 100 test users.
